summary: No findings; round 1 had none to verify. Since round 1 only rejectionsOverBudget's projection (now subtracts z*sqrt(remaining*(1-pHi))/pHi), comments and a test changed. Edge cases: remaining = 0 gives projected = 0 (no NaN). The only caller (equity.ts:410-412) invokes it only when rejections is a positive multiple of SAMPLER_CHECK_EVERY; with rejections r > 0, pHi < 1 holds whenever z^2*accepted < r^2 + r*z^2, i.e. accepted < ~1.06M at r = 8192, and accepted <= trials (30,000), so 1 - pHi > 0 and the sqrt argument is non-negative. pHi > 0 always (z^2/2 term), so no divide-by-zero. A negative projection is possible near completion but only makes the early abort less eager; even a NaN would compare false. Either way the unconditional hard cap `++rejections > maxRejections` still bounds the loop and throws the same RangeError, so it still fails closed and termination is unchanged. The new test uses the seeded Xoshiro128 only in tests; no change to deck/bot RNG, dependencies, secrets or logging.
